subject: or_legislature/2025R1/SJR4
title: Proposes an amendment to the Oregon Constitution providing that the Legislative Assembly shall provide by law for indexing the rate of any motor vehicle fuel tax to inflation. Refers the proposed amendment to the people for their approval or rejection at the next regular general election.
headline: SJR 4 did not pass

claims.text: SJR 4 was introduced in the Senate on January 13, 2025.
SJR 4 was still in a Senate committee when the session ended. Last recorded step: June 27, 2025.
Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
SJR 4 is a proposed change to the Oregon Constitution. It would have gone to voters if passed; it did not pass, so it will not be on your ballot.
